integrity: Symbolic degree-four stationary generator identities and semigroup formulas replayed by verify.py; the existence argument and global analytic limits are separately supplied in RESULT.md. No independent external scientific review.
scientific_limitations: Independent coordinate reset clocks of one rate, one independent environmental reset clock, independent Brownian drivers and the squared Brownian environmental amplitude only. Algebraic critical behavior pertains to a ratio of vanishing covariances, not to nondecaying correlations; large-dimensional conclusion uses second moments only. Publication priority is not established against undiscovered works.
title: Critical synchronization of squared-displacement correlations under independently reset fluctuating diffusivity
